svg.title: Cost per Review by Model and Effort
svg.desc: Strip plot of 810 review costs on a log scale, one row per model and effort. Opus 5.5 (preregistered): geometric means low $0.0397, medium $0.0805, high $0.1009; medium/high cost ratio 0.798 (95% BCa 0.750 to 0.849). Sonnet 5.5 (exploratory): geometric means low $0.0210, medium $0.0241, high $0.0392; medium/high cost ratio 0.614 (95% BCa 0.573 to 0.656). Haiku 5.5 (exploratory): geometric means low $0.0021, medium $0.0031, high $0.0063; medium/high cost ratio 0.487 (95% BCa 0.447 to 0.531).
svg.text: Cost per Review by Model and Effort
Each dot is one review; the dark bar is the geometric mean. Log cost scale.
810 reviews, 90 per model and effort. H3 threshold for the medium/high geometric-mean cost ratio: .70.
